title: Standing-Order Months Missed Over Twelve Months, PAP Supply Replenishment Program
content:
**Rule.** Months the standing order missed are made up on a standing-order cushion line of the Self-Pay Supply Subscription, PAP Supply Replenishment Program. The standing-order months missed in the last 12 months are 12 less the months that the standing-order lines of the latest standing-order item shipped in that span cover at that line's units per month, the difference rounded down to a whole month and never below zero:

- when two or more were missed, **two months of units** are added;
- when exactly one was missed, **one month of units** is added;
- otherwise nothing is added.

A month of units is the units per month of the line being booked. Made-up units are added before the units shipped are rounded down to a whole unit, and made-up units do not extend the line's covered-through date.

## Counting the missed months

- **Standing-order lines:** self-pay cushion lines on the enrollment that went out by ground; the latest of them fixes the item and its units per month (its units divided by the months it covered).
- **In the last 12 months:** ship date fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the handling day.
- **Months covered at that rate:** the units of the latest standing-order item on those lines, divided by the latest line's units per month.
- **Missed months:** 12 less those months, rounded down to a whole month and never below zero.

## Worked examples (hypothetical)

| Latest line's units per month | Units of that item on standing-order lines in 12 months | Months covered | Missed | Added |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2 | 18 | 9 | 3 | two months of units |
| 2 | 22 | 11 | 1 | one month of units |
| 2 | 24 | 12 | 0 | nothing |
| 2 | 21 | 10.5 | 1.5, rounded down to 1 | one month of units |
